reference: The visa application form (Form No. 17), passport, a standard photo and the fee; an official document of the country of citizenship verifying that the applicant is an overseas Korean with foreign nationality; and a certificate of medal or commendation, or an award certificate, awarded by a Minister of the central government.
answer: The required documents for Embassy visa application — Case 6 are: ① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee [1] ② Official document of the country of citizenship verifying you are overseas Koreans with foreign nationality [1] ③ Certificate of medal/commendation or award certificate awarded by the Minister of the central government [1]
